svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-04
svg.desc: Electrocute visual endpoints and unified damage parameters.
svg.text: 2026-08-04 - Beam endpoints and unified damage parameters
main | 2 commits: da80879, 5c57678
Daily job
Make Electrocute visually correct and give graph damage actions one parameter contract.
Beam endpoints/range, cursor target data, Apply/Cause/hitscan/projectile/shards/beam builders, and graph smoke registration changed.
BEFORE
Visual and gameplay parameters diverged
Beam line endpoints/range were unreliable.
Target data and cursor handling varied.
Damage producers built parameters separately.
A visible hit did not guarantee usable attribution.
AFTER
Beam presentation and damage contract align
Electrocute computes visual start/end endpoints and enforces range.
Cursor and target-data handling feed the beam path consistently.
ApplyDamage, CauseDamage, hitscan, projectile, shards, and beam share parameter construction.
Graph module registration and smoke coverage track the shared path.
Guard: line presentation and gameplay attribution are related but separate checks.
Important guard
A correct beam line is not enough.
Verify shared damage parameters and target
context independently.
Validation / newcomer path
Follow endpoint calculation, target data, then
FDamageEffectParams across each producer.
The graph smoke registration closes the loop.
